presence unconfirmed; if present exclude from denominator, if absent flag as unavailable
provider-modeled field, not raw NFL data; safe as optional passthrough if disclosed as such

unsafe_or_out_of_scope_for_v0.note: no dedicated field; requires rusher identity/role join, forbidden by this issue's own non-goals

special_teams_exclusion.note: already handled correctly by existing play_type in [pass,run] filter shape in compute.py

under_center_derivation_decision.reason: shotgun==0 cannot be safely relabeled under_center because pistol-formation handling in the source is unverified in this session, and there is no dedicated pistol field in the documented schema
under_center_derivation_decision.rule: missing/null shotgun values must fall into unknown_or_unclassified_alignment_plays, never default to non_shotgun or under_center
under_center_derivation_decision.under_center_label_unlocked_only_after: a live nflreadpy.load_pbp() pull confirms pistol-snap treatment

denominator_rules.base_filter: posteam not null AND (pass==1 OR rush==1 OR play_type in [pass, run])
additional_required_exclusions_not_in_ex: no-play rows (independent of pass/rush flag values, not relying on them)
not_requiring_special_handling_at_v0: qb_scramble (already correctly bucketed as rush via play_type/rush indicator)

success_rate_conflict_finding.finding: src/team_state/definitions.py and compute.py already define a TIBER-specific success rule (>=40% ydstogo on 1st down, >=60% on 2nd, 100% on 3rd/4th), independent of any native nflverse success column
success_rate_conflict_finding.risk: silently adopting nflverse's own success field under the same field name would create two divergent 'success' definitions across sibling TIBER-Data artifacts
success_rate_conflict_finding.recommendation: reuse the existing TIBER team_state success rule verbatim for formation_summary_v0; if nflverse's native field is used instead, name it distinctly (e.g. epa_success_rate vs distance_success_rate)

justification: formation_lens_v0 (Teamstate) is a season-level explanation surface, does not need weekly granularity
team_week multiplies sample-size risk 18x before alignment ambiguity (shotgun/pistol) is resolved
recommended_grain.team_week_deferred_until: team_season coverage and alignment ambiguity are resolved and sample-size/warning behavior is proven reliable

envelope.hard_rule: governance/provenance status is never inferred from file path, file name, branch name, or consumer intent

fields: shotgun_success_rate (optional, gated, must use TIBER team_state success definition)
row_shape.null_vs_zero: optional efficiency fields remain absent/null/insufficient_data until EPA/success definitions are source-backed and sample thresholds are met

sample_size_thresholds.small_sample_behavior: suppress the efficiency/prose field entirely, do not merely attach a warning; rate/count fields may still be emitted with a sample_notes flag
sample_size_thresholds.league_relative_labels_in_v0: not allowed; no league-baseline artifact exists yet in this repo; deferred

fail_closed_rules: required source fields unavailable at build time -> fail closed
unknown_or_unclassified_alignment_plays exceeding 10% of offensive_plays for a row requires an explicit high-uncertainty flag
denominator rule must be applied consistently and stated in artifact metadata
emitting non_shotgun under the label under_center is a hard validation failure
missing source snapshot/version, sourceRefs, or governance/provenance markers fails validation
sample-size thresholds must be declared and enforced
shotgun_plays + non_shotgun_plays + unknown_or_unclassified_alignment_plays must equal offensive_plays exactly
success field must disclose which definition (TIBER team_state rule vs nflverse native) was used

relationship_to_lanes.tiber_team_state_v0_1: closest sibling; shares offensive-play-filter pattern but that pattern must be tightened for this artifact (no-play/kneel/spike); must not fork the success-rate definition silently
relationship_to_lanes.formation_lens_v0_teamstate: downstream consumer, not started here; remains blocked from real-data interpretation until this artifact exists and passes a separate consumption approval
relationship_to_lanes.player_season_coverage_v0: shape/vocabulary precedent only (truth_status vocabulary, envelope shape); no code/data dependency
relationship_to_lanes.fantasy_forecast: out of scope entirely; not referenced by any field/grain/envelope choice here
